rules.accepted_credit_types: AVMA; AVMA-accredited schools; federal/state/county veterinary associations and USDA; NAVTA Journal and NAVTA-approved online CE; RACE courses; other courses approved by the Board
rules.new_licensee_rule: Prorated: under 6 months licensed - none; 6-12 months - 3 h; 12-24 months - 6 h.
rules.alternatives: Written extension or exemption request (illness, absence, hardship) at least 60 days before expiration.
rules.audit_note: Random audits; keep a CE log and attendance proof; CE entered in the DELPROS CE tracker.
rules.notes: Board renewal page: licenses expire July 31 of even years; Rule 9.1 says odd years - year parity unclear. No online limit stated.
